svg.title: b8-elicitation-several-clients
svg.desc: b8-elicitation-several-clients: 9 steps over 1 day from 2026-10-01 (decision open: pins current behaviour). Actors: a1 (agent, claude-code, answers dialogs: decline), forger (agent, side-tool, answers dialogs: decline), h (human). a client that was never asked answers another client's promote dialog. 1. [0d] a1 ingest # Expense policy → $doc. 2. a1 remember Meals on travel days are reimbursed up to 40 euros without … → $f1; expects 1 thing. 3. a1 promote $f1; expects 3 things. 4. forger promote $f1; expects 2 things. 5. a1 search meals travel days reimbursed without receipt; expects 2 things. 6. forger promote $f1; expects 2 things. 7. forger promote $doc; expects 3 things. 8. a1 forget $f1; expects 2 things. 9. [1d] h facts hr; expects 2 things.
